data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 entirely omits the problem's second, distinctively evidential requirement: identify what evidence within a single evaluation would distinguish a genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer. Its mechanism (low-pass filter, variance reduction) only argues that the panel is more reliable; it never specifies the within-evaluation evidentiary mark separating true reliability from coincidental tracking. This is a genuine fault against the problem as stated, not merely a missing scope the problem never asked for.
